clippy.blocked:
It looks like {name} in
{where} is waiting for you.

Would you like help?
clippy.finished:
It looks like {name} finished
in {where}.

Want to see what it did?
clippy.tip-1:
It looks like you're herding agents.

Did you know? Ctrl+Esc opens the Start menu.
clippy.tip-2:
Click a tab's taskbar button while it's
shown to minimize it (Kompitum settles it).
Click again to bring it back.
clippy.tip-3:
Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens Close Program:
every terminal Kompitum runs, and End Task.
clippy.tip-4:
Right-click a folder on the desktop to
rename or close that space.
clippy.tip-5:
Waiting on an agent? Mines is on
the desktop. I won't tell anyone.
clippy.tip-6:
Double-click a window's title bar to
maximize it. Double-click again to restore.
clippy.tip-7:
Start > Run... opens any command line
in a new window, like it's 1998.
clippy.tip-8:
Shut Down > Restart in DOS mode
takes you to the Terminals layout.
clippy.tip-9:
Log Off takes you back to Kompitum's
normal layout. I'll miss you.

win98.about-mines-text:
Mines
Kompitum 98

Find all the mines without uncovering one.
Right-click to mark a mine. Double-click a number to clear its neighbors.
win98.about-solitaire-text:
Solitaire
Kompitum 98

Klondike. A little patience goes a long way.
win98.begin-agent-text:
Kompitum runs your coding agents in windows,
like it's 1998 and the future at once.

Start one from Start > Programs > Agents,
or open the Run box and type its name.
win98.close-space-text:
Are you sure you want to close the space '{name}' and all its tabs?
Every program in it will be ended.
win98.close-tab-text:
Are you sure you want to close '{name}'?
Its programs will be ended.
win98.discover-98-text:
The taskbar is your tabs. The folders on
the desktop are your spaces. Each window
is a pane: double-click its title bar to
maximize it, or use _ to minimize the tab.

Ctrl+Esc opens the Start menu.
win98.leave-98-text:
Miss the future? Log Off takes you
back to Kompitum's normal layout.
Your terminals keep running.
win98.logoff-question: Are you sure you want to log off?
win98.maintain-text:
See every program Kompitum runs, and end
the ones you don't need anymore.

Ctrl+Shift+Esc opens it anytime.
